Team —

We need a quick, surgical recalibration of the Q3 renewal forecast and a stage audit for a handful of high-ARR accounts. Goal: get accurate commits or downgrade to at-risk so finance has clean figures for the May close. Please follow the steps below by EOD Thursday, May 6 (PST).

1) Update HubSpot stage and commit reason for these accounts: Varelly (VRL-231) and Acme Corp (ACME-990). If legal/procurement is still in play, mark as "Final Negotiation" and include expected sign date. If nothing substantive since last touchpoint, mark as "At Risk".
2) For any account you move to Commit, add a one-line rationale and the committed ARR/renewal date in the deal notes.
3) Flag any account where we have a pending credit/discount request and escalate to Naomi for approval.
4) Attach any supporting docs to the HubSpot record (SLA notes, pricing redlines).

I've attached a working sheet: Q3_renewal_touchpoints.xlsx (stub). Also linking the HubSpot records for quick access.

Account specifics to prioritize:
- Varelly (VRL-231): Customer success reports a positive product ROI but procurement asked for extra SLA language; current rep says this is likely a commit pending SLA signoff.
- Acme Corp (ACME-990): Low usage trend; CS suggests churn signal — needs immediate owner follow-up before we mark commit.

Please reply in-thread with your updates (stage changes + short rationale). If you need me to join a customer call to unblock SLA wording, say so and I'll schedule.

Thanks —
Hannah
